1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA
  That the City Council waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the agenda and
  declare that said titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read
  by title and further reading waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, to adopt the
  Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Vargas, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Del Rio
  RECUSE: 0;

C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to receive, file, and provide comments on the Citywide Bicycle Master Plan
  proposed network prepared by Toole Design Group.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, presented the staff report.

  Roger Pelayo, Toole Design Group, provided a presentation.

  Lila Singer­Berk, Toole Design Group, continued the presentation.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  A discussion ensued between Toole Design Group, Neema Ghanbari, Public Works
  Manager; Ernesto Marquez, City Manager; and Councilmember Roa.

  Mayor De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation.

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, reported that the closing ceremonies for the
youth basketball season will be held next week; Saturday will be the kickoff for the rugby season; and the
Spring Summer guide has been mailed to residents.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that a Block Clean Up event will be held on March
22, 2025.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor De Paula reported that he attended the Read Aloud program at Furgeson Elementary and
Hawaiian Elementary.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

1.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957.6
  Agency­designated representative: Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
  Employee Organizations: AFSCME Local 3624 Management Unit Union

  Patrick Donegan, City Attorney, read the Closed Session Item into the record.

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 6:39 PM.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 7:07 PM.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

  Patrick Donegan, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:07 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, March 26, 2025 at 6:00 PM.
